tools.name: qbo_get_company_info

tools.name: qbo_list_customers

where.description: WHERE clause filter, e.g. "Active = true" or "DisplayName LIKE '%John%'"

tools.name: qbo_get_customer
tools.description: Get a specific customer by ID

tools.name: qbo_create_customer
tools.description: Create a new customer in QuickBooks

tools.name: qbo_update_customer
tools.description: Update an existing customer. Requires the current SyncToken.

sync_token.description: SyncToken from the current customer record (required for updates)

tools.name: qbo_list_invoices
tools.description: Query invoices with optional filters and pagination

tools.description: Create a new invoice for a customer with line items

tools.description: Update an existing invoice. Requires SyncToken.

sync_token.description: SyncToken from the current invoice record

tools.name: qbo_profit_and_loss
tools.description: Generate a Profit & Loss (Income Statement) report. Filter by date range, accounting method, and grouping.

date_macro.description: Predefined date range: Today, This Month, This Quarter, This Year, Last Month, Last Quarter, Last Year

summarize_column_by.description: Grouping: Total, Month, Week, Quarter, Year, Customers, Vendors

tools.name: qbo_balance_sheet
tools.description: Generate a Balance Sheet report showing assets, liabilities, and equity

tools.name: qbo_report
tools.description: Run any QuickBooks report: ProfitAndLoss, ProfitAndLossDetail, BalanceSheet, GeneralLedger, CustomerBalance, CustomerBalanceDetail, VendorBalance, VendorExpenses, InventoryValuationSummary, ItemSales

report_name.description: Report name: ProfitAndLoss, ProfitAndLossDetail, BalanceSheet, GeneralLedger, CustomerBalance, CustomerBalanceDetail, VendorBalance, VendorExpenses, InventoryValuationSummary, ItemSales

tools.name: qbo_query
tools.description: Execute a raw SQL-like query against any QuickBooks entity. Supports SELECT, WHERE (=, <, >, LIKE, IN), ORDER BY, and pagination (STARTPOSITION, MAXRESULTS). No OR operator, no JOINs. Example: SELECT * FROM Invoice WHERE TotalAmt > '500' ORDER BY TxnDate DESC MAXRESULTS 10

query.description: SQL-like query string. Supported entities: Customer, Invoice, Payment, Item, Estimate, Bill, Vendor, Account, Employee, TimeActivity, Purchase, JournalEntry, TaxRate, TaxCode, CreditMemo, Deposit, SalesReceipt, Transfer, VendorCredit, Class, Department, PaymentMethod, Term. Example: SELECT * FROM Invoice WHERE TotalAmt > '100' AND CustomerRef = '5' ORDER BY MetaData.CreateTime DESC STARTPOSITION 1 MAXRESULTS 50
